title: Nadine Samonte, Richard Chua renew wedding vows after 13 years of marriage
summary: Actress Nadine Samonte and her husband, businessman Richard Chua, renewed their wedding vows in an intimate ceremony in Tagaytay on Wednesday, October 28, marking their 13th wedding anniversary.
